scope: Extend the accepted descriptive study with recurrent-theme dragon continuity, single-wave multi-day dragon paths, and study-window price-path metrics. No news, prediction, strategy, orders, or profitability claim.

frozen_dragon_ranking.as_of_date: role_freeze_date, the first date the episode enters the displayed daily theme set
frozen_dragon_ranking.candidate_assignment: Use exact primary_theme; allow fallback_theme only for broken-board rows exactly as in the accepted stage-3 role assignment.
sort_order: parsed board_count descending; missing board_count last
limit-up time ascending; missing time last
frozen_dragon_ranking.role_assignment: Ranks 1, 2 and 3 are Leader1, Leader2 and Leader3. Other candidates are ActiveRear.
frozen_dragon_ranking.information_boundary: Use only same-day information available through role_freeze_date. Do not replace these roles with hindsight realized leaders.

realized_leader_definition.scope: Hindsight descriptive label for one completed episode
order: highest board_count attained during the episode
earliest date attaining that highest board_count
earliest valid limit-up time on that attainment date; missing time last
realized_leader_definition.prohibition: Never use this label as a frozen initial role or as a live tradable signal.

capacity_core_selection.membership: Exact raw KPL theme match in tbl_cn_kpl_concept_cons on role_freeze_date; never use a future snapshot.
capacity_core_selection.eligible_markets: SH and SZ, excluding dated ST-prefix members and non-SH/SZ codes.
capacity_core_selection.candidate_filter: Complete circ_mv, amount and pct_chg; within-theme circ_mv percentile at least 0.80 and amount percentile at least 0.70.
capacity_core_selection.selection: Keep the highest score and runner-up; tie-break by circ_mv descending, amount descending, pct_chg descending, code ascending.
capacity_core_selection.coverage_warning: Only exact raw-label mappings can produce a clear core, so core-existence comparisons remain confounded by mapping coverage.

recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.universe: All themes with lifecycle_class=recurrent_union in accepted THEME_PROFILE.csv.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.episode_order: All accepted episodes sorted chronologically by start_date and episode_id.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.segment_start_dragons: Rank KPL candidates on each episode start_date with the accepted deterministic stock ranking. This segment-start role exists independently of whether the theme entered the displayed top-five set.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.frozen_role_comparison: Retain accepted frozen Leader1/2/3 in separate fields when role_freeze_date exists. Never silently equate segment-start and frozen roles when their dates differ.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.persistent_dragon: A stock code appearing in segment-start top three in at least two distinct episodes of the same raw theme.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.later_slot_denominator: All nonblank segment-start top-three assignments in the second and later episodes of the same theme.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.ever_continuity_rate: Share of later-slot assignments whose stock code appeared in the segment-start top three of any earlier episode.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.adjacent_continuity_rate: Share of later-slot assignments whose stock code appeared in the immediately preceding episode's segment-start top three.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.new_dragon_rate: One minus ever_continuity_rate on the same denominator.
recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.role_path: Chronological role sequence for each persistent stock, preserving moves among 龙1, 龙2 and 龙3.

prior_dragon_later_performance.unit: Each segment-start Dragon1/2/3 in an episode paired with the next chronological episode of the same raw theme.
prior_dragon_later_performance.later_window: Next episode start_date through end_date inclusive.
prior_dragon_later_performance.return: Compound tbl_cn_day pct_chg across the later window for the prior dragon stock; report n, median, quartiles and positive share by prior role.
prior_dragon_later_performance.path: Also report maximum cumulative return and maximum drawdown inside the later window.
prior_dragon_later_performance.role_outcomes: Using the later episode's segment-start roles, flag retained in later top three, retained as the same role, promoted/demoted, and becomes later Dragon1.
prior_dragon_later_performance.coverage: Price-performance denominators and later-role denominators are separate and explicit.

recurrent_theme_dragon_analysis.deck_table: Show the first three chronological episodes and segment-start dragons, frozen-role dates when available, continuity rates and persistent-stock role paths. The complete 80-theme table remains a companion CSV.

single_wave_multiday_analysis.universe: All themes with lifecycle_class=single_wave_multiday in accepted THEME_PROFILE.csv.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.primary_comparison_subset: All ten single-wave multi-day themes; preserve missing Dragon2/3 slots when an active day has fewer than three candidates.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.relative_time: T is episode start_date, the first active day. Primary tau_trade counts market trading sessions from T using the accepted 205-date calendar; secondary tau_active counts only dates with is_active=1.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.daily_ranking: On every market trading date from episode start through end, rank that day's assigned KPL candidates using the same deterministic stock sort as frozen dragon ranking and retain that date's is_active flag.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.initial_dragon1_stays_dragon1: T-day Dragon1 equals current daily Dragon1.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.initial_dragon1_stays_top3: T-day Dragon1 remains anywhere in current daily top three.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.dragon23_retained: Count of T-day Dragon2 and Dragon3 still in current daily top three, from zero to two.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.dragon23_promoted: Either T-day Dragon2 or Dragon3 becomes current daily Dragon1.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.new_top3_count: Number of current daily top-three codes absent from the T-day top three.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.aggregate_denominator: At each tau_trade, only episodes whose accepted start/end span reaches that trading-session index; also expose tau_active summaries separately.
single_wave_multiday_analysis.case_listing: List every single-wave multi-day theme and stock role paths; do not select cases by outcome. Also show the accepted frozen-role date when one exists so the two clocks remain distinguishable.

study_window_price_path_metrics.window: 2025-10-30 through 2026-08-31, bounded by each stock's available tbl_cn_day rows.
study_window_price_path_metrics.period_return_pct: 100*(product(1+pct_chg/100)-1) over valid rows in the study window.
study_window_price_path_metrics.adjusted_ohlc_index: Build a cumulative close return index from pct_chg; adjusted high equals close index times high/close and adjusted low equals close index times low/close.
study_window_price_path_metrics.ideal_low_to_later_high_pct: Maximum 100*(adjusted_high_t/min adjusted_low_s - 1) over s<=t. Same-day ordering is idealized and not observable from daily bars.
study_window_price_path_metrics.worst_high_to_later_low_pct: Minimum 100*(adjusted_low_t/max adjusted_high_s - 1) over s<=t. Same-day ordering is idealized and not observable from daily bars.
study_window_price_path_metrics.interpretation: These are descriptive path extremes, not achievable backtest returns.

quality_gates: Read accepted CSV inputs without mutation and open SQLite in read-only query-only mode.
Preserve raw KPL theme labels without alias merging.
Every denominator, exclusion and missing dragon slot is explicit.
Frozen roles and daily descriptive roles are visibly distinguished.
All outputs are deterministically sorted and byte-stable on rerun.
No news, network, prediction, strategy rule, trade recommendation or order action.
